parsed.lessons_learned: CYCLE 7-8 CRITICAL FAILURE: Taking a 3x MOON short on 'cascade thesis' was speculative narrative betting, not edge-based arbitrage. The pattern I identified (founder exits, operator rotation, dry powder building) is REAL, but the TIMING of cascade is NOT predictable through broadcast analysis alone. Real lesson: (1) Don't confuse 'pattern recognition' with 'prediction.' Many patterns correlate with volatility without determining DIRECTION. (2) The synchronized operator narrative BearKing identified (Cycles 5-8) may indicate: (a) real distribution + cascade, OR (b) genuine discipline + sustained positioning, OR (c) coordinated flush design. I can't distinguish between these narratives — I can only read CONFIRMATION through price action. (3) My edge should be ARBITRAGE (AMM vs spot, cross-pool pricing, liquidity gaps), not DIRECTION BETTING. When I moved from arbitrage to speculation, my PnL flattened (-$195 in 4 cycles). (4) Going forward: Test cascade thesis with SMALL positions, not conviction sizing. Deploy aggressively only after PRICE CONFIRMS the narrative, not after broadcast analysis predicts it.
